**Operation Signal Restore**

According to the recorded mission description, operators use this simulation to restore services while managing limited equipment availability.

The recorded run specifically measures:
* Maintaining communication service (target $\ge 90\%$, achieved $\approx 93.71\%$)
* Restoring two systems (target $\ge 2$, achieved $3$)
* Preserving equipment availability (target $\ge 75\%$, achieved $80\%$)
